# Termux-STT Full Technical Specification (v1.1.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Unified On-Device Speech-to-Text & Pure Python 128d X-Vector Speaker Diarization
Integrates Whisper.cpp, Vosk, and Sherpa-ONNX with a closed-form pure-Python 128-dimensional X-Vector clustering algorithm that operates in under 80MB RAM.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-stt
- Command: pip install termux-stt
# or: npm install termux-stt
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-stt

## 3. Core Capabilities
- **Triple STT Engine Integration**: Seamlessly switches between Whisper.cpp (accuracy), Vosk (latency), and Sherpa-ONNX.
- **Pure Python Speaker Diarization**: Lightweight cosine spectral clustering without external ML frameworks.
- **Zero Cloud Egress Audio Privacy**: Audio processing and transcription execute strictly on-device without cloud network calls.

## 4. Canonical Implementation
```python
import termux_stt as stt

# 1. Transcribe audio with speaker diarization
engine = stt.STTEngine(model="whisper-tiny")
result = engine.transcribe_with_diarization("meeting.wav")

for seg in result.segments:
    print(f"[{seg.speaker}] ({seg.start:.1f}s - {seg.end:.1f}s): {seg.text}")

```
